article_title: ASP.NET Core 请求路径参考：Path、PathBase 和 URL 拼接
core_theme: ASP.NET Core 中 HttpRequest 将请求 URL 拆分为 PathBase、Path、QueryString 等独立属性，理解它们的关系和正确使用方式
reader_takeaway: 搞清楚每个请求路径属性该在什么场景用，避免手动拼接 URL 踩坑
summary_angle: 一个完整 URL 被拆成三个标注块（PathBase / Path / QueryString），再重新拼回完整地址，直观展示拆分与组合关系

information_blocks.source_anchor: PathBase 是应用前缀，由中间件或反向代理配置决定，可为空
information_blocks.visual_idea: 左侧一个标注为 PathBase 的 URL 前缀段被高亮切分出来

information_blocks.source_anchor: Path 包含应用内部路由路径，与 PathBase 分开管理
information_blocks.visual_idea: 中间一个标注为 Path 的 URL 路径段

information_blocks.source_anchor: QueryString 和 Query 用于读取查询参数
information_blocks.visual_idea: 右侧一个标注为 QueryString 的查询参数段

main_metaphor: 一个 URL 地址栏被解析成三个带标签的彩色积木块，拼在一起形成完整地址
primary_subject: 一根水平展开的 URL 地址栏，被拆分为三个颜色不同的标注段
subject_action: URL 段从左到右依次排列，箭头和标注说明每个段的含义，最后重新组合成完整 URL
composition: 单点聚焦，水平方向从左到右展开三个信息块

final_prompt:
Use case: infographic-story
Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article
Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes the article. Theme: ASP.NET Core splits a request URL into PathBase, Path, and QueryString properties — understanding how they split and combine. The reader should quickly feel confident about which property to use in each scenario.

Summary angle: A complete URL is split into three labeled segments (PathBase / Path / QueryString), then reassembled back into a full address, showing the split-and-combine relationship at a glance.
Narrative flow: 3-beat process. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject and 2-4 supporting narrative beats. Each beat must map to the article's information blocks rather than generic decoration.
Information blocks:
- Step 1: PathBase is the app prefix, configured by middleware or reverse proxy, can be empty. Visual: left URL segment highlighted and labeled "PathBase", with a small "①" chip.
- Step 2: Path contains the route path inside the application, separated from PathBase. Visual: middle URL segment labeled "Path", with a small "②" chip.
- Step 3: QueryString carries query parameters. Visual: right segment labeled "QueryString" and a "?" marker, with a small "③" chip.

Main metaphor: A horizontal URL address bar parsed into three color-coded labeled building blocks that snap together to form the complete address.
Subject: A horizontally laid-out URL address bar, split into three distinctly colored segments with labels, arrows connecting them back to a complete URL at the bottom.
Composition/framing: single focal point, horizontal left-to-right flow of three information blocks. Prefer horizontal or radial storytelling that stays legible in a wide cover.
Style/medium: combine editorial technical illustration with the selected visual style descriptor: colored-pencil picture-book illustration, tactile strokes, gentle palette, warm narrative objects, soft educational tone. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist.
Color palette: warm cream background, soft blue, warm orange, dark gray labels.
Visible text policy: allow only 1-3 short Chinese labels or number chips by default, and no more than 4 when strictly necessary, all sourced from the information blocks. Each label <= 6 Chinese characters or one required product/model name. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names.
Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter.
Avoid: floating chips, meaningless code rain, neon skyscraper backgrounds, generic robot poses, cyberpunk purple-blue light pollution, fake terminal windows, fake browser screenshots, fake dashboards.
